props.text: Drawn 340 meters below granite scree with zero heavy chlorination

props.html: Rain and snowmelt filtering down the Serra da Estrela massif spend decades dissolving silica and alkaline bicarbonates before rising at 40.2°C directly into our basins.
Bicarbonate (HCO₃⁻) · Alkaline granite buffer keeping the skin’s lipid mantle calm without soap tightness.
Metasilicic Acid (H₂SiO₃) · Dissolved highland quartz imparting natural thermal slip across basalt benches.
Magnesium & Calcium · Transdermal earth ions easing lower-limb fatigue after steep mountain ascents.
Skin-Neutral Wellhead · Artesian pressure feeds all four basins at 1,420 mg/L total dissolved solids.
Closed-Vessel UV-C & Ozone · Continuous turnover eliminates chlorine odor so steam vaults stay crisp.
